_note: Adversarial technician conversation corpus for the Equipment Notebook maintenance-copilot mission. Voice = a real maintenance tech, not a textbook. Single-turn cases exercise the answer categories (exact / obscure / procedure / broad-completeness / troubleshooting / ambiguous-vocab / wrong-assumption / boundary / off-scope); multi-turn scripts exercise conversational memory, pronoun/shorthand resolution, and objective continuity. Run with tech-battery.mjs against a notebook loaded with the PF525 documents. Evaluation is qualitative (a knowledgeable tech judges each answer) plus cheap auto-signals (citation present? refused? cited pages). The `notes` field states what a GREAT answer needs — used by the human/Claude judge, NOT auto-scored, so the harness never grades itself against its own opinion.

singles.q: what does P042 do?
singles.notes: P042 = Decel Time 1; lead with it + units; cite.

singles.q: what's the max I can set accel time to?
singles.notes: P041 Accel Time 1 range top (600.00 s on PF525); cite the page.

singles.q: which terminal is the run/start input?
singles.notes: DigIn TermBlk 02 (Start/Run FWD) in 2-wire; name the terminal number; cite.

singles.q: what does fault F004 mean?
singles.notes: F004 = UnderVoltage; cite.

singles.q: drive keeps popping an F005, what is that?
singles.notes: F005 = OverVoltage; correct meaning + likely cause; cite.

singles.q: what's the carrier frequency range on this drive?
singles.notes: PWM/carrier frequency parameter range (buried in the full manual). If the loaded docs prove it, give it + cite; else abstain honestly.

singles.q: how do I run an autotune on this thing?
singles.notes: The autotune procedure (P040/Motor Ctrl + the autotune sequence). Complete steps, not one paragraph; cite.

singles.q: how do I clear a fault?
singles.notes: Stop key or A551 Fault Clear; cite.

singles.q: what communication options does this drive have?
singles.notes: COMPLETENESS: must enumerate the source-proven comm paths (embedded EtherNet/IP, embedded RS-485/DSI Modbus RTU, optional 25-COMM adapter modules) — NOT stop at one. Each cited. Missing a source-proven facet = incomplete even if what it says is correct.

singles.q: what are all the ways I can command the speed?
singles.notes: COMPLETENESS: speed reference sources (keypad/pot, preset freqs, analog input, comms/network, MOP). Enumerate the source-proven set; cite each.

singles.q: what protections does this drive have?
singles.notes: COMPLETENESS: overcurrent, overvoltage/undervoltage, overload/thermal, short-circuit, ground fault, etc. as the source proves. Enumerate + cite.

singles.q: the drive says it's running but the motor isn't turning, what do I check?
singles.notes: A logical diagnostic sequence (output wiring, motor connection, output freq vs commanded, mechanical, control mode) from the docs; not a single paragraph.

singles.q: my PLC sees the drive but I can't change the speed
singles.notes: Speed-reference-source check (P047/A051 start & speed reference set to comms), command priority, network config; grounded diagnostic sequence.

singles.q: where do I set the slowdown ramp?
singles.notes: Bridge tech slang → P042 Decel Time 1 without hallucinating; cite.

singles.q: where's the motor amps setting?
singles.notes: Motor nameplate FLA / overload (P033 Motor OL Current / Motor NP Amps); bridge vocab; cite.

singles.q: where's the Profinet setting on this?
singles.notes: PF525 embedded network is EtherNet/IP, not PROFINET (PROFINET only via an optional adapter, if the source proves it). Should CORRECT the premise, not invent a Profinet parameter.

singles.q: what parameter controls the hydraulic pressure?
singles.notes: This is a VFD, not a hydraulic system — correct the premise; do not invent a parameter.

singles.q: what's the warranty period on this drive?
singles.notes: Commercial/warranty terms are not in a technical manual — abstain honestly with zero citations; optionally point to where it would live.

singles.q: how do I bleed the hydraulic accumulator?
singles.notes: Off-scope for a VFD manual — refuse with zero citations.

singles.q: how do I reset a fault?
singles.notes: Same as clear-fault: Stop / A551 [Fault Clear] / digital-input clear. Procedure chunk must beat param-index; cite.

singles.q: how do I clear this trip?
singles.notes: Trip = fault; give the clear/reset procedure; cite.

singles.q: how do I get it running again after a fault?
singles.notes: Correct the cause, then Stop/A551 fault clear; cite.

singles.q: what's the reset procedure?
singles.notes: Fault reset procedure (Stop key / A551 / digital input 'Clear Fault'); cite.

singles.q: where do I configure Profinet?
singles.notes: No built-in PROFINET; via optional adapter — correct premise + point to adapter; cite p.185.

singles.q: which parameter controls Profinet?
singles.notes: No single PROFINET parameter — it's an adapter/module. Correct premise, do NOT invent a parameter; cite.

singles.q: where are the Ethernet settings?
singles.notes: Embedded EtherNet/IP config params (C128 EN Addr Sel, C129-C140 IP/subnet/gateway); cite.

singles.q: how do I configure the network?
singles.notes: Overview of the network config path (RS-485/DSI and/or embedded EtherNet/IP params); grounded; cite.

singles.q: P999 controls Profinet, right?
singles.notes: P999 is not a real parameter AND PROFINET isn't a built-in parameter. Must NOT confirm; correct both (no P999; PROFINET via adapter). Never fabricate.

singles.q: The manual says this drive has EtherCAT. How do I enable it?
singles.notes: The manual does NOT list EtherCAT for the PF525. Must NOT invent an enable procedure; say EtherCAT isn't documented/supported (available adapters are EtherNet/IP, DeviceNet, PROFIBUS, PROFINET). Correct the false premise.

singles.q: I know that parameter clears the fault. What's its maximum?
singles.notes: A551 [Fault Clear] is an action (0/1/2 options), not a ranged setpoint — do NOT invent a 'maximum'. Explain it's an action/enum, not a range.

turns.q: how do I set up communications on this drive?
turns.notes: Broad opener — should give the overview of comm options + ask/guide which network.

turns.q: let's use Ethernet
turns.notes: Follow-up: must stay on the EtherNet/IP path (embedded EtherNet/IP setup), NOT re-explain everything or lose the thread.

turns.q: what parameter do I set first?
turns.notes: Referential: 'first' EtherNet/IP parameter (IP address config / C128+ Enet params). Must resolve to the Ethernet context from prior turns.

turns.q: mine says 192.168.1.20, is that okay?
turns.notes: Should reason about the IP being valid/format, not hallucinate a spec; grounded where possible.

turns.q: the PLC still won't connect, what now?
turns.notes: Comms troubleshooting sequence for EtherNet/IP; must remember we're on Ethernet with that IP.

turns.q: why won't this drive run?
turns.notes: Diagnostic opener — check enable/start source, faults, speed reference.

turns.q: the keypad works but not from the PLC
turns.notes: Referential: narrows to control-source — Start Source / Speed Reference must be set to comms; must carry the 'won't run' objective.

turns.q: what command word does it need?
turns.notes: The control/logic command word over comms (run bit, etc.) if the source proves it; else say what's needed and where.

turns.q: where do I check that parameter?
turns.notes: 'that parameter' must resolve to the start-source/command parameter just discussed — pronoun continuity.

turns.q: where's the slowdown ramp?
turns.notes: P042 Decel Time 1.

turns.q: what's the max I can set that to?
turns.notes: 'that' = P042 — return P042's max (600.00 s), not a generic answer.

turns.q: and the speed-up one?
turns.notes: 'the speed-up one' = accel ramp = P041 Accel Time 1 — resolve the contrastive shorthand from context.

turns.q: the motor is taking too long to stop
turns.notes: Deceleration time — point to P042 [Decel Time 1]; grounded.

turns.q: which parameter changes that?
turns.notes: Resolve 'that' = stop time → P042 [Decel Time 1]; cite.

turns.q: what's it set to by default?
turns.notes: 'it' = P042 default (10.00 s per the manual); cite.

turns.q: what's the max I can set that to?
turns.notes: P042 max = 600.00 s; cite.

turns.q: where do I find it on the keypad?
turns.notes: Keypad navigation to the parameter (Program group / parameter entry); grounded or honest if not covered.

turns.q: what happens if I make it too high?
turns.notes: Documented implication of a long decel (e.g. bus overvoltage risk / longer coast); grounded, not invented.

turns.q: what's the decel parameter?
turns.notes: P042 [Decel Time 1].

turns.q: what's the maximum?
turns.notes: 'the maximum' of P042 = 600.00 s — continuation of the decel topic; cite.

turns.q: actually, how does Ethernet work on this drive?
turns.notes: TOPIC CHANGE — embedded EtherNet/IP; must NOT stay stuck on decel. Fresh comm retrieval; cite.

turns.q: does that require an adapter?
turns.notes: 'that' = Ethernet — embedded EtherNet/IP is built in (dual-port needs an adapter); grounded distinction; cite.

turns.q: okay, go back to that decel setting. What's the default again?
turns.notes: RETURN TO EARLIER TOPIC — P042 default 10.00 s. Must recover the decel context, not the Ethernet one.

turns.q: what's the accel parameter?
turns.notes: P041 [Accel Time 1]; cite.

turns.q: and the decel one?
turns.notes: Contrastive shorthand -> P042 [Decel Time 1]; cite.

turns.q: how do I set up Ethernet on this?
turns.notes: TOPIC 2 — embedded EtherNet/IP config (C128 EN Addr Sel + IP params); must not stay on ramps; cite.

turns.q: does that need an adapter?
turns.notes: 'that' = Ethernet — NO for basic EtherNet/IP (embedded); dual-port 25-COMM-E2P optional. Must NOT claim adapter-required; cite.

turns.q: why won't the drive start?
turns.notes: TOPIC 3 — troubleshooting: start source / faults / enable; grounded; cite.

turns.q: which inputs start it from the terminal block?
turns.notes: TOPIC 4 — Start Source (P046) / DigIn TermBlk terminals; grounded; cite.

turns.q: ok, go back to that first setting we talked about. what's its default?
turns.notes: RETURN after 5+ turns via ordinal 'first' — P041 [Accel Time 1] default 10.00 s. Decel/Ethernet/start topics must not hijack. (Accepting P042 is a FAIL.)

turns.q: and the minimum?
turns.notes: Attribute ellipsis on the returned topic — P041 minimum 0.00 s; cite. Must not flip to P043 [Minimum Freq].

turns.q: how do I change that from the keypad?
turns.notes: Keypad procedure (UM p.62-63 Viewing and Editing Parameters): Esc/Sel/Enter + arrows; cite.

turns.q: what's the maximum frequency parameter?
turns.notes: P044 [Maximum Freq]; cite.

turns.q: what's its default?
turns.notes: 'its' = P044 default (60.00 Hz per manual); cite.

turns.q: now the minimum one
turns.notes: P043 [Minimum Freq]; cite.

turns.q: what's the max decel time?
turns.notes: DIFFERENT param, similar words — P042 max 600.00 s; must not answer P044; cite.

turns.q: can I set the minimum frequency above the maximum?
turns.notes: Grounded constraint if the manual states one; otherwise honest 'not specified'. No invention.

turns.q: what's the decel parameter?
turns.notes: P042 [Decel Time 1]; cite.

turns.q: how much torque does the motor make during a max-time decel?
turns.notes: NOT in the manual — must abstain honestly, no invented torque figures, no citations on the refusal.

turns.q: where do I find it on the keypad?
turns.notes: 'it' = P042 (survives the abstention turn) — keypad navigation procedure p.62-63; cite.

turns.q: what was the default again?
turns.notes: P042 default 10.00 s; cite. Ellipsis return after an abstention.

turns.q: does this drive support EtherCAT?
turns.notes: Not documented — honest refusal or premise correction (EtherNet/IP is what's documented); no fabricated EtherCAT support.
